title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 8: wisdom crying out at the gates and her place beside Yahweh before the earth existed.

questions.text: Where does wisdom stand and cry aloud at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: Wisdom stands on the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, and cries aloud beside the gates, at the entry of the city.

answers.text: In the desert and the wilderness
In the courts of the temple
In the house she has built
Beside the gates, at the entry of the city

questions.text: What does wisdom say is an abomination to her lips?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "My mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips."

questions.text: Wisdom says to receive her instruction rather than what?
questions.explanation: The verse says: "Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold."

questions.text: How does wisdom define the fear of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The verse says: "The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth."

questions.text: How does wisdom's saying continue: "By me kings..."?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "By me kings reign, and princes decree justice."

questions.text: What does wisdom promise to those who seek her diligently?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me."

questions.text: When does wisdom say Yahweh possessed her?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old."

answers.text: In the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old
On the day he made mankind upon the earth
In the days when kings first reigned on the earth
When the gates of the city were first built

questions.text: What does wisdom say about herself at the time Yahweh established the heavens?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep."

answers.text: She was hidden in the depths
She was waiting at the gates

questions.text: What was wisdom by Yahweh's side during his work of creation?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "Then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him."

questions.text: What does wisdom say about all those who hate her?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says: "He who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death."

answers.text: They will be put to shame
They will seek her and not find her
